title: Complete-subcategory mate agrees with the ordered strict-tower exchange
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a chosen Cartesian square with arrows g-prime:X-prime to X, f-prime:X-prime to Y-prime, f:X to Y and g:Y-prime to Y [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Use the canonical coefficient datum d=pbcIntegralDatum l E [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and complete-subcategory operations and mate [lem-sbc-completed-operations-linear-natural-exchange]. For every intrinsically complete input K on X there exist isomorphisms s:(sbcPull g)(sbcPush f)K ≅ d.completedPull g (d.push f K) and t:(sbcPush f-prime)(sbcPull g-prime)K ≅ d.push f-prime (d.completedPull g-prime K) such that sbcExchangeApp(exchangeTransposeSquare square,K).hom ≫ t.hom = s.hom ≫ d.completedExchange(square,K). The datum exchange is the ordered map of [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map]. No properness, smoothness, dimension, boundedness or constructibility assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Use lem-sbc-completed-operations-linear-natural-exchange for the normalized ordinary pullback and its right-adjoint mate comparison. Compare strict tower pullback with the datum presentation using lem-cbc-completed-extension-zero-comparison, then apply derived inverse limit. Evaluate at the direct image of the complete input for the source; apply direct image to the pullback comparison for the target.

proof.text: The specified complete-subcategory mate satisfies the ordinary-to-completed unit equation by lem-sbc-completed-operations-linear-natural-exchange. The datum exchange satisfies that same equation by lem-weil-pbc-completed-exchange-unit. Ordinary module tensor maps agree and resolving counits identify their ordinary derived mates. The compositor normalization is lem-sbc-reflected-compositor-unit-normalization; the reflector mate factorization is lem-sbc-reflector-square-mate-factorization. Both transported arrows consequently agree after the source unit.

proof.text: The target is intrinsically complete by preservation under pullback and direct image. The Hom bijection of the completion reflection cancels the source completion unit, proving the displayed exchange equality. This applies without constructible or geometric restrictions, including zero input and empty schemes.

theorem sbcDatumExchangeComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g) (K : PbcComplete l E X) :
    ∃ (source : ((sbcPull l E g).obj ((sbcPush l E f).obj K)).obj ≅
        ((pbcIntegralDatum l E).completedPull g).obj
          (((pbcIntegralDatum l E).push f).obj K.obj))
      (target : ((sbcPush l E f').obj ((sbcPull l E g').obj K)).obj ≅
        ((pbcIntegralDatum l E).push f').obj
          (((pbcIntegralDatum l E).completedPull g').obj K.obj)),
      (sbcExchangeApp l E (exchangeTransposeSquare sq) K).hom ≫ target.hom =
        source.hom ≫ (pbcIntegralDatum l E).completedExchange sq K.obj
